content.content: The journal is a fifth file interface: journal entry files under `.deccy/journal/` and content-addressed blobs under `.deccy/objects/`, opened on the one repo root, landed by atomic replacement, untracked, with no generic read or write over arbitrary paths.
content.rationale: S2-ifs gives each file kind its own handle; the journal is a new kind — entry documents plus byte blobs — and giving it its own interface keeps the store, the marker file and the exclude file from gaining reach through it. It lands by S2-atomic's replacement rule and stays untracked with the rest of `.deccy/`, so it never enters the graph's history.
